references.text: Isaiah 55:6 urges seeking the Lord while He may be found, a theme echoed in Jesus' words that one must seek Him before it is too late.
In John 8:21, Jesus repeats almost verbatim the warning that those who do not believe will seek Him and not find Him, and that they cannot go where He is.
John 13:33 contains a parallel statement where Jesus says that those who seek Him cannot go where He is, underscoring the same dividing line between believers and unbelievers.

Jeremiah 29:13-14 promises that those who seek God with all their heart will find Him, a conditional promise that contrasts with Jesus' warning that those who do not seek Him in the right way will not find Him.
